title: How to Use the Trade Terminal in Project P.I.T.T.
description: Updated for 1.0.5 — The Trade Terminal clears products; players report the right-side switch vacuums items. If access is blocked, use Pause → Clear Items (no refund).
h1: How to Use the Trade Terminal in Project P.I.T.T.
quickAnswer: Updated for 1.0.5 — The Trade Terminal clears/vacuums products; a player-tested right-side switch can vacuum them, and if piles block access use Pause Menu → Clear Items (official, no refund).

facts.label: Trade Terminal
facts.value: Used to clear/remove or vacuum products from the scene.

facts.label: Right-side switch
facts.value: Player-tested Steam report: the switch on the right can vacuum products.

facts.label: Clear Items (pause menu)
facts.value: Official 1.0.5 update: adds a Pause Menu → Clear Items button to remove annoying items that can cause crashes or unplayable scenes.

facts.label: Clear Items refund
facts.value: Official 1.0.5 note: Clear Items will not give back any money.
